notes.title: Better visual clarity during races
notes.content:
Changes in version 2.1.5:


 Changed looks of the health bar and exhaust gases to better reflect the degradation of the engine
 Added braking lights to show AI steering decisions

notes.title: Improved Junkyard in Version 2.1.4
notes.content:
Version 2.1.4 introduces a number of quality-of-life changes:


 There is one more improvement tear available to purchase in the junkyard.
 Junkyard re-roll animations gradually speed up during a session to make excessive re-rolling less tedious.
 Previous tutorial screens can be accessed by talking to a wise goblin in town.
 You can see your progress towards the card-buying achievements by hovering over the achievement on the options screen.

notes.title: Update notes for version 2.1.3
notes.content:
Changes in version 2.1.3:

 Changed championship seating so that top teams have a bigger advantage
 Slight change in off-road balancing of the desert track
 Added a new goblin driver

notes.title: Hotfix version 2.1.2
notes.content: A bug was fixed where you would get the wrong achievement after finishing a race.

notes.title: Spanish Font Fix
notes.content: Fixed some minor issues with the Spanish Font.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 2.1.1
notes.content:
Gameplay Changes

 Tracks can be driven in counter clockwise order for more variety in the races.
 Car physics information can be shown and hidden with a key press.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028835/468273e4ec3737dab8b41d5f84179192edce72bc.png

New Languages
The Goblin Auto Club Manager interface was translated to new languages.


 Spanish
 Brazilian Portuguese
 Japanese
 French
 Korean


Bug Fixes

 Fixed Unicode character input
 Added missing cup image in breaking news articles

notes.title: 3 New Race Tracks in Goblin Auto Club Manager
notes.content:
We created three new race tracks and one new league. Check them out!

New Race Tracks

 PacGoblin
 Bomber Goblin
 Epic PinGoblin (Super Gobroid)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028835/264d28623bd66ef50e6c2c636087c498a8eabf51.png

New League
We have a new final league: Retro. This league has the hardest enemies and the championship takes place on the three new tracks.
You can join the Retro League after winning the World League championship.

Other changes

 Changed icons for loading and saving setups at the mechanic
 Keyboard shortcuts for increasing and decreasing driver aggression added

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.1.3
notes.content:
Quality of life features

 Pitstop automatically ends when the car is fully repaired. You can still stop the pitstop early.
 There is a skip race button in addition to the reroll race button. Skipping a race is a shortcut for entering the cheapest race and being last in that race.

Balancing updates

 The desert track was modified to simplify overtakes.
 The desert track has a catch-up mechanic. The dust still damages cars behind but it also makes them quicker.

Graphics updates

 Added content creator reference to small waterfall track
 Fixed bug in true madness map

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.1.2
notes.content:
Some players have already completed the game. Others don't like the grind. So we decided to add a difficulty selector to the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028835/b17775f167e5415c6fa8918e2f06ff0e86f47929.png
Available difficulties

 Easy: For players who don't like the grind.
 Normal: The original experience. Either grinding or great strategies will allow you to win.
 Hard: This difficulty requires both, grinding and great strategies.
 Insane: Other race teams get better with every race. Either you win quickly or you don't win at all.

Bugfixes

 Junkyard price bug
 Accidental stats as numbers shortcut keypress

Other

 Adjusted some items for better balance
 Graphics updates on tracks Small Waterfall and True Madness

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.0.3
notes.content:
Quality of life changes:

 Possibility to customize key bindings
 Possibility to change aggression with mouse wheel
 Possibility to toggle between numbers and bars using a key
 Show items that can no longer be updated in junkyard


Bugfixes:

 Fixed description when exchanging races
